entries.title: The PC is not dead: it's about usage not units
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013, more than 80 percent of Internet traffic measured in bits will continue to come from traditional desktop and laptop personal computers.
entries.metric: share of Internet traffic (bits) from desktop and laptop PCs
entries.subject: Personal computers

entries.title: Bring your own computer: a tale of two interpretations
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013, very few additional companies will adopt a bring-your-own-computer (BYOC) policy, and some of those that already have one will abandon them.
entries.subject: Bring your own computer (BYOC)

entries.title: P@$$1234: the end of strong password-only security
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013 more than 90 percent of user-generated passwords, even those considered strong by IT departments, will be vulnerable to hacking.
entries.metric: share of user-generated passwords vulnerable to hacking
entries.subject: Password security

entries.title: Enterprise Social Networks: another tool, but not yet a panacea
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that by the end of 2013 more than 90 percent of Fortune 500 companies will have partially or fully implemented an Enterprise Social Network (ESN), a 70 percent increase over 2011.
entries.metric: share of Fortune 500 with an enterprise social network
entries.subject: Enterprise social networks

entries.title: Let's get together: crowdfunding portals bring in the bucks
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that crowdfunding portals will raise $3 billion in 2013, double the $1.5 billion raised in 2011.
entries.subject: Crowdfunding

entries.title: The button stays beautiful
entries.quote: A growing range (tens rather than hundreds) of high-end TV sets are likely to incorporate gesture or voice based controls in 2013, Deloitte predicts.
entries.metric: number of high-end TV models with gesture or voice control
entries.subject: TV remote control and gesture/voice interfaces

entries.title: 4K kicks off
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013 the television industry will commence the roll-out of the next generation of high definition (HD) TV, known as 4K
entries.subject: 4K television

entries.title: Dual video screening readies for prime time
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013, about ten percent of households in developed countries, and about three percent of households in developing countries, will dual video screen their television consumption on a monthly basis.
entries.metric: share of developed-country households dual video screening monthly
entries.subject: Second-screen TV viewing

entries.title: Connected TV: hits and misses
entries.quote: In 2013, Deloitte predicts that tens of millions of connected TV sets will sell globally, and the installed base of TV sets with integrated connectivity should exceed 100 million.
entries.metric: installed base of connected TV sets
entries.subject: Connected TV

entries.title: Over-the-top may lift legacy broadcasters and distributors more than pure plays
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013, in markets where services are available, two of the top three over-the-top (OTT) TV program and movie services are likely to be provided by existing broadcasters and distributors.
entries.metric: top-three OTT services run by legacy broadcasters/distributors
entries.subject: Over-the-top video

entries.title: The reality of "cord cutting" in North America
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013 almost all North American households that pay for TV through multichannel video programming distributors (MVPD) will continue to subscribe.
entries.subject: Pay TV cord cutting

entries.title: A strong year for LTE adoption
entries.quote: More than 200 operators in 75 countries will have launched a Long Term Evolution (LTE) network by the end of 2013, Deloitte predicts.
entries.subject: LTE / 4G deployment

entries.title: Smartphones ship a billion but usage becomes simpler
entries.quote: In 2013, Deloitte predicts that global shipments of smartphones ... will likely exceed one billion units for the first time.
entries.subject: Smartphone shipments

entries.title: "Mobile" advertising is dead. Long live tablet and smartphone advertising
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013, what is currently described as "mobile" advertising will get split into two categories representing two similar but distinct devices – tablets and smartphones.
entries.subject: Mobile advertising

entries.title: All-you-can-app
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2013 between 50 and 100 mobile operators will offer all-you-can-eat services with unlimited access to specific applications.
entries.metric: mobile operators offering unlimited app-specific plans
entries.subject: Zero-rated app data plans

entries.title: The looming spectrum shortage: worse before it gets better
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that although additional spectrum will continue to be made available in 2013 in many global markets, spectrum exhaustion will continue to exacerbate in many countries, especially in dense urban areas.
entries.subject: Mobile spectrum

notes: Launched January 2013 (Deloitte collection page). A midyear checkpoint infographic and podcast followed (gx-tmt-predictions2013-midyear-infographic.pdf), not captured. Rank is the order in the report.
